exercises.benchPressDesc: Flat bench with barbell. Primarily chest, secondarily triceps and front delts.
exercises.inclineBenchPressDesc: Incline bench (30-45 degrees) with barbell. Emphasizes upper chest.
exercises.dumbbellFlyesDesc: Fly movement with dumbbells on flat bench. Stretches and isolates the chest.
exercises.cableCrossoverDesc: Cable from high to low crossover. Good chest isolation.
exercises.chestDipsDesc: Dips with forward lean. Trains chest and triceps with bodyweight.
exercises.chestPressMachineDesc: Guided chest press machine. Ideal for beginners.
exercises.deadliftDesc: Compound barbell exercise from the floor. Trains entire back and legs.
exercises.pullUpsDesc: Bodyweight exercise on the bar. Primarily lats and biceps.
exercises.barbellRowDesc: Bent-over row with barbell. Trains the upper back.
exercises.latPulldownDesc: Cable pulldown to chest. Alternative to pull-ups.
exercises.seatedCableRowDesc: Seated rowing on cable machine. Trains the mid back.
exercises.dumbbellRowDesc: Single-arm row with dumbbell. Good lat isolation.
exercises.overheadPressDesc: Barbell pressed overhead. Primarily front and lateral delts.
exercises.lateralRaiseDesc: Dumbbells raised to the sides. Isolates the lateral deltoid.
exercises.facePullDesc: Cable pulled to face height. Trains rear delts and rotator cuff.
exercises.frontRaiseDesc: Dumbbells raised to the front. Isolates the front deltoid.
exercises.reverseFlyesDesc: Seated dumbbell reverse fly. Trains the rear deltoid.
exercises.barbellCurlDesc: Curls with barbell. Fundamental bicep exercise.
exercises.dumbbellCurlDesc: Curls with dumbbells, alternating or simultaneous.
exercises.hammerCurlDesc: Curls with neutral grip. Trains biceps and brachialis.
exercises.preacherCurlDesc: Curls on preacher bench. Isolates biceps through fixed position.
exercises.tricepPushdownDesc: Cable pushed downward. Fundamental tricep exercise.
exercises.skullCrushersDesc: Barbell lowered to forehead while lying. Intense tricep exercise.
exercises.overheadTricepExtensionDesc: Dumbbell extended behind head. Emphasizes long tricep head.
exercises.tricepDipsDesc: Dips with upright body. Focus on triceps.
exercises.squatDesc: Compound barbell exercise. Trains quads, glutes, and core.
exercises.legPressDesc: Guided leg press machine. Trains the entire leg musculature.
exercises.lungesDesc: Walking or stationary lunges with dumbbells. Trains legs and balance.
exercises.romanianDeadliftDesc: Deadlift with straight legs. Focus on posterior chain.
exercises.hipThrustDesc: Hip extension with barbell on bench. Best exercise for glutes.
exercises.cableKickbackDesc: Leg kickback on cable machine. Isolates the glutes.
exercises.gluteBridgeDesc: Hip raise on the floor. Activates glutes with bodyweight.
exercises.crunchesDesc: Classic ab exercise. Trains the upper abs.
exercises.hangingLegRaiseDesc: Raise legs while hanging from bar. Trains lower abs.
exercises.cableCrunchDesc: Crunches on cable machine for progressive overload.
exercises.plankDesc: Static hold position. Trains the entire core.
exercises.calfRaiseStandingDesc: Standing on calf raise machine. Trains the gastrocnemius.
exercises.calfRaiseSeatedDesc: Seated on calf raise machine. Trains the soleus.
exercises.wristCurlDesc: Curl dumbbell with wrists. Trains forearm flexors.
exercises.reverseWristCurlDesc: Curl dumbbell with reverse grip. Trains forearm extensors.
exercises.runningDesc: Run outdoors or on a treadmill. Improves endurance and cardiovascular fitness.
exercises.cyclingDesc: Cycle outdoors or on a stationary bike. Low-impact endurance exercise.
exercises.ellipticalDesc: Full-body cardio on the elliptical machine. Easy on the joints.
exercises.rowingMachineDesc: Full-body cardio on the rowing machine. Trains back, arms, and legs simultaneously.
exercises.swimmingDesc: Swim in a pool or open water. Low-impact full-body workout.
exercises.burpeesDesc: Full-body exercise: push-up, jump, repeat. Extremely effective for conditioning.
exercises.mountainClimbersDesc: In push-up position, alternate driving knees to chest. Cardio and core.
exercises.jumpSquatsDesc: Squats with explosive jump. Trains legs and jumping power.
exercises.highKneesDesc: Run in place with high knees. Quick heart rate boost.
exercises.boxJumpsDesc: Jump onto an elevated box. Trains explosive power and coordination.
exercises.battleRopesDesc: Swing heavy ropes in wave motions. Intense upper body cardio.
exercises.kettlebellSwingsDesc: Swing kettlebell between legs. Trains hips, back, and conditioning.
exercises.pushUpsDesc: Classic push-ups. Trains chest, shoulders, and triceps with bodyweight.
exercises.jumpingJacksDesc: Spread arms and legs simultaneously. Warm-up and cardio exercise.
exercises.wallSitDesc: Hold sitting position against a wall. Isometric leg exercise.
exercises.stepUpsDesc: Step onto and off a bench or step. Trains legs and balance.
exercises.bodyweightSquatsDesc: Squats without weight. Fundamental leg and glute exercise.
exercises.shadowBoxingDesc: Boxing combinations in the air without an opponent. Perfect for warmup and technique.
exercises.heavyBagRoundsDesc: Rounds on the heavy bag. Trains punching power, endurance, and combinations.
exercises.padWorkDesc: Combinations on pads with a partner. Trains precision and reaction time.
exercises.speedBagDesc: Training on the speed bag. Improves hand-eye coordination and rhythm.
exercises.slipAndRollDesc: Practice slipping and rolling head movements. Defensive boxing technique.
exercises.kickCombosDesc: Punch-kick combination drills. Foundation of kickboxing.
exercises.roundhouseKickDrillDesc: Repeated roundhouse kick practice. Trains technique and hip rotation.
exercises.thaiClinchDesc: Muay Thai style clinch work. Knee techniques and control.
exercises.lowKickDrillDesc: Repeated low kicks to thigh level. Fundamental kickboxing technique.
exercises.groundAndPoundDesc: Ground fighting with strikes from top position. Core MMA technique.
exercises.takedownDrillDesc: Repeated takedown practice. Single-leg, double-leg, and clinch throws.
exercises.sprawlDrillDesc: Takedown defense practice. Explosive leg sprawl movement.
exercises.cageWorkDesc: Cage/wall work for MMA. Applying pressure and controlling position.
exercises.kataPracticeDesc: Form practice: fixed sequence of techniques. Trains form and concentration.
exercises.kihonBasicsDesc: Karate fundamentals: punches, blocks, and kicks in basic stance.
exercises.kumiteSparringDesc: Free sparring with a partner. Applying techniques under pressure.
exercises.makiwaraTrainingDesc: Striking practice on the Makiwara board. Strengthens fists and improves technique.
exercises.uchikomiDrillDesc: Repeated entry into throwing techniques without completing the throw. Trains timing and coordination.
exercises.nagekomiDesc: Throwing technique training with a partner. Repeated throwing to perfect technique.
exercises.newazaDrillDesc: Judo ground techniques. Practicing pins, chokes, and joint locks.
exercises.randoriDesc: Free practice sparring in Judo. Applying all techniques with a partner.
exercises.guardPassingDesc: Drills for passing the guard position in BJJ. Technique and pressure building.
exercises.sweepDrillDesc: Sweep techniques from various guard positions. Reversing control.
exercises.submissionFlowDesc: Flowing through submission chains. Armbars, chokes, and leg locks.
exercises.bjjRollingDesc: Free rolling in Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu. Ground sparring with rotating partners.
exercises.poomsaeDesc: Forms practice in Taekwondo. Fixed sequence of techniques for perfection.
exercises.turningKickDrillDesc: Repeated practice of the turning kick (Dollyo Chagi). Core Taekwondo technique.
exercises.sparringTkdDesc: Competition-style Taekwondo sparring with protective gear.
exercises.boardBreakingDesc: Breaking boards or tiles with strikes/kicks. Trains power, technique, and mental focus.
exercises.singleLegDrillDesc: Repeated single-leg takedown practice. Fundamental wrestling technique.
exercises.doubleLegDrillDesc: Double-leg takedown. Explosive shot and lift of the opponent.
exercises.wrestlingConditioningDesc: Wrestling-specific strength and endurance training. Bridges, sprawls, and crawls.
exercises.matReturnsDesc: Techniques for returning the opponent to the mat from standing position.

plans.title: Training Plans
plans.pushPullLegsDesc: 3-day split: Push, pull, and leg exercises. Ideal for intermediate to advanced.
plans.upperLowerDesc: 2-day split: Upper and lower body alternating. Good for beginners to intermediate.
plans.fiveDaySplitDesc: Each muscle group on its own day. For advanced lifters.
plans.confirmDeletePlan: Delete plan? You can restore it from "Deleted Plans".
plans.confirmPermanentDelete: Permanently delete plan? This action cannot be undone.
plans.boxingBasicsDesc: 6 rounds of classic boxing training. Shadow boxing, heavy bag, pads, and defense.
plans.kickboxingWorkoutDesc: 5 rounds of kickboxing with punch-kick combos, clinch, and low kicks.
plans.mmaConditioningDesc: 5 rounds of MMA training. Takedowns, ground & pound, sprawls, and cage work.
plans.karateTrainingDesc: 4 rounds of Karate. Kihon basics, kata, kumite, and makiwara.
plans.couchTo5kDesc: Running program for beginners. From the couch to your first 5K.
plans.cyclingEnduranceDesc: Cycling with increasing duration and distance for better endurance.
plans.tabataDesc: 8 rounds: 20 seconds all-out, 10 seconds rest. Extremely effective in 4 minutes.
plans.hiit3030Desc: 10 rounds: 30 seconds work, 30 seconds rest. Balanced and intense.
plans.fullBodyCircuitDesc: 3 rounds with 6 exercises. 40 seconds work, 20 seconds rest.
plans.coreCircuitDesc: 4 rounds with 4 exercises. 30 seconds work, 15 seconds rest. Core focus.
